LightningComponentBundle.description: Pipeline funnel chart powered by D3.js with conversion rate labels and drill-down.

property.name: groupByField
property.label: Group By Field
property.description: API name of the category field (e.g., StageName)

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field to aggregate (not required for Count)

property.name: hideConversionRates
property.label: Hide Conversion Rates
property.description: When checked, hides conversion rate percentages between funnel segments

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Drill-Down Object
property.description: Object API name for navigation on segment click

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Group By Field)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to process. Leave empty for default.

property.name: fetchMode
property.label: Data Source
property.description: How to fetch data: auto (existing priority order), apex (Apex-backed SOQL), or graphql (UI API GraphQL)
